documents.content:
Employee Handbook

Paid Time Off
Employees receive 15 days of paid time off each calendar year.

Remote Work
Employees may work remotely up to three days each week.

Office Hours
Core office hours are 10:00 AM to 3:00 PM local time.

Probation Period
New employees have a 90-day probation period.

Expense Policy

Expense Approval
Expenses above $500 require manager approval.

Airfare
Airfare should be booked in economy class unless a director approves otherwise.

Receipts
Receipts are required for expenses above $25.

Security Policy

Passwords
Passwords must be at least 14 characters long.

Multi-Factor Authentication
MFA is required for all internal systems.

Credential Sharing
Employees must not share credentials with anyone.
